Finds the tops of the trees as the local maxima of a canopy height model, in a window of fixed size or as wide as the crowns expected for the height.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › vegetation<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Maxima, Trees, Lidar<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterMaximaFinder`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inDsmDtmDiff` | raster file |  |  | The canopy height model: the height of the surface over the ground. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `custom` | The window: custom, of the given size in cells, or as wide as the crowns of mixed_pines_and_deciduous_trees, deciduous or conifer trees of the height of the cell. Allowed values: `custom`, `mixed_pines_and_deciduous_trees`, `deciduous`, `conifer`. |
| `pThreshold` | double |  | `1.0` | Threshold on maxima. Only maxima higher than the threshold are kept. |
| `pSize` | int |  | `3` | The windows size in cells to use for custom mode (default is 3). |
| `pPercent` | int |  | `60` | The percentage of the crown width used as window (default is 60%). This is ignored in custom mode. |
| `pMaxRadius` | double |  | `3.0` | The maximum radius of the window, in meters. This is ignored in custom mode. |
| `doCircular` | boolean |  | `true` | Use a circular window instead of a square one, for windows larger than 3 cells. |
| `doAllowNovalues` | boolean |  | `false` | If false, a maximum with more than one novalue among its 8 neighbours is discarded. |
| `pBorderDistanceThres` | double | m | `-1.0` | If larger than 0, the maxima closer than this to the border of the canopy over the threshold get a note, as near a border, but are kept. |
| `pTopBufferThres` | double | m | `5.0` | The drop of a neighbour from the maximum over which it counts for the spikes. |
| `pTopBufferThresCellCount` | int |  | `2` | The number of neighbours lower than the top buffer threshold that make a maximum a spike, to discard; 0 disables the check. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMaxima` | output file |  | The maxima, with an id, their height (elev) and a note. |
| `outCircles` | output file |  | The windows of the maxima, as circles, with the id of the maximum (id_maxima) and their area. |

**References**

- Popescu, S. C., Wynne, R. H. (2004). Seeing the trees in the forest: using lidar and multispectral data fusion with local filtering and variable window size for estimating tree height. Photogrammetric Engineering & Remote Sensing, 70(5), 589-604.
